vulnerability.name: CVE-2023-54404
vulnerability.description: Zod Uncontrolled Resource Consumption via Unbounded Array, Set, and Map Validation

statements.status_notes: Backported upstream fix (colinhacks/zod commit a0ebf970f2d752e5f58527cd2942ff48be4f46bd) into zod@3.25.76 via pnpm patchedDependencies (patches/zod@3.25.76.patch) for both v3 (ZodArray/ZodSet) and v4 ($ZodArray/$ZodSet/$ZodMap) parse paths. Verified via PoC: 200,000 invalid elements against .max(2) fail fast in ~1.3ms with 1 too_big issue and zero element iteration. zod-v4 catalog upgraded to 4.6.7.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-93753
vulnerability.description: Withdrawn Advisory: deepmerge mergeObject() allows prototype poisoning of returned objects

statements.impact_statement: GitHub Advisory GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4 has been officially withdrawn. As defense-in-depth, patches/deepmerge@4.3.1.patch additionally blocks __proto__, constructor, and prototype keys in propertyIsUnsafe().
